dataset.name: date3k2/raw_real_fake_images
dataset.sampling: 100 real + 100 AI images, evenly spaced across the split
dataset.license_note: The dataset card states no license. Only scores and statistics are published here; no images are redistributed.

variants.normalized: Center-cropped square, resized to 512 px, JPEG q90 (controls for size/format shortcuts)

limitations: 200 images from one dataset; confidence intervals are wide.
Real photos are mostly ~800 px; AI images are square 512/1024/1536 px (see group breakdown).
Generators in this set are older than the newest commercial models; a miss on a modern generator (e.g. GPT-image) has been observed in manual use and is not captured by these numbers.

calibration.note: Reliability on a balanced 50/50 sample; real-world prevalence differs, so these scores are not calibrated probabilities.
